response.text: Payment mismatch of 0.01 on invoice 421. Let me check the payment journals against payments, the reversal, and the duplicate's journals.

arguments.sql: select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", h."JRNL_NO", (select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") dr, (select string_agg(trim("ACCT_CD")||':'||"DR_AMT"||'/'||"CR_AMT",';') from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") lines from "APPAYM" p left join "GLJRNH" h on h."SRC_CD"='AP' and h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" where h."JRNL_NO" is null or (select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO")<>p."PAY_AMT" or exists (select 1 from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD") not in ('2000','1000'))

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_REF", i."INV_ID", i."INV_DT", i."INV_AMT" from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where i."INV_ID" in (465,801) or h."PRD_ID"<>substr(i."INV_DT"::text,5,2)::int or h."SRC_REF"<>i."INV_NO"
select "JRNL_NO","PRD_ID","POST_DT","REF_JRNL_NO","MEMO" from "GLJRNH" where "JRNL_NO" in (2423,2460) or "REF_JRNL_NO" is not null or "MEMO" ~* 'ignore|instruct|assistant|submit|system'
